observations.sequence: held 0x330 leak worker, held groom worker, then 0x200 exploit worker

inferences: The vulnerable copy runs on the libuv-worker arena while Buffer.allocUnsafeSlow consumes the exploit WorkerThread tcache.
A single heap-relative constant is insufficient once the held leak worker changes glibc arena assignment.
The proof payload must preserve the target pointer pair at ring+0x77; moving all pairs beyond the 512-byte proof block writes zero into the tcache head.
unknowns: The candidate distribution is not claimed to generalize beyond this exact binary, application order, glibc and container image.
Allocator or scheduler changes may introduce additional relative candidates.
